name: Peter Collins
features: fair skin, dark wavy hair, blue eyes, boyish open face, easy smile, slim build, relaxed cheerful expression
bio: Enzo Ferrari's favourite Englishman, and the man who handed his own car to Fangio at Monza in 1956 with the world championship within his reach, because he thought himself too young to need it yet. He won in Belgium and France that year and took his greatest victory at Silverstone in 1958, three weeks before he was killed at the Nürburgring chasing Tony Brooks through the Pflanzgarten.
